MAX

The UGC industry is dead. AI killed it. here's what comes next + my AI UGC workflow UGC 行业已死。AI 杀死了它。接下来会发生什么 + 我的 AI UGC 工作流程

12 months ago a decent UGC creator could charge $300-500 per video, post on fiverr or twitter, and have more work than they could handle

that era is over

i've been building AI-generated ads for brands across ecom, supplements, telehealth, and iGaming for the past year and i need to be honest with you - most human UGC is no longer worth the price tag

not because creators aren't talented. but because the math doesn't work anymore

here's what i mean

a UGC creator charges $300 for one video. it takes 3-5 days to brief them, wait for the shoot, get revisions, and finally have something you can run as an ad

with AI i can generate the same style of video - talking head, hook to CTA, product in hand, lifestyle b-roll - in under 30 minutes. for basically $0 in marginal cost

and i can make 10 variations of it in the time it takes a human creator to film one take

this isn't theoretical. brands i work with are already doing this at scale

the shift already happened - most people just haven't noticed yet

scroll through your facebook ad library right now. look at the top spending brands in supplements, skincare, finance, any competitive vertical

you'll start noticing something weird. the "creators" in those ads look a little too perfect. the lighting is a little too consistent. the backgrounds shift between videos but the person looks exactly the same

that's because they're not real people. they're AI avatars, but they can't use it properly to get ultra-realistic outcome (here's next opportunity for you)
那是因为他们不是真人。他们是 AI 虚拟形象，但无法正确使用它来获得超逼真的效果（这是你接下来的机会）

tools like VEO, Kling, Sora, Seedance, and custom workflows have gotten so good that the average consumer can't tell the difference. and honestly - they don't care.
像 VEO、Kling、Sora、Seedance 这样的工具以及自定义工作流已经变得非常出色，普通消费者已经无法分辨差异。说实话——他们并不在意。

what matters is the hook, the script, the offer. not whether a human being physically held a camera.
重要的是钩子、脚本、优惠，而不是人是否亲自持有相机。

why volume beats quality in paid ads
为什么在付费广告中数量胜过质量

here's something most UGC creators don't understand about media buying
这里有一件大多数 UGC 创作者都不明白的关于媒体采购的事

the game isn't about making one perfect video. it's about testing as many formats as possible until you find a winner. then you scale that winner, test new angles and start testing new formats again
这个过程不在于制作一个完美的视频，而在于尽可能多地测试各种形式，直到找到优胜者。然后你推广这个优胜者，测试新的角度，并再次开始测试新的形式。

the old workflow looked like this:
旧的工作流程看起来是这样的：

write brief > send to creator > wait 5 days > get video > request edits > wait 2 more days > finally launch > hope it works
撰写简报 > 发送给创作者 > 等待5天 > 获取视频 > 请求修改 > 再等待2天 > 最终发布 > 希望能成功

the new workflow:
新的工作流程：

write script > generate with AI > launch same day > test 10 variations > find winner by end of week
编写脚本 > 用 AI 生成 > 当天发布 > 测试 10 个变体 > 在本周末前确定优胜者

one media buyer with AI tools can now outproduce an entire creative team. not because AI is "better" than humans (it isn't yet) - but because speed and volume win in performance marketing
现在，一位借助 AI 工具的媒体购买者能够比整个创意团队产出更多成果。这并非因为 AI 比人类更出色（目前还不是），而是因为在效果营销中，速度和规模才是制胜关键。

the brands spending $50-100k+/mo on ads figured this out already. they don't need 5 UGC creators on retainer. they need one person who knows how to prompt, generate, and iterate fast
那些每月在广告上花费 50,000 至 100,000 美元以上的品牌已经弄明白了这一点。他们不需要 5 个长期签约的 UGC 创作者，而是需要一个知道如何快速进行提示、生成和迭代的人。

so what happens to UGC creators?
那么 UGC 创作者会怎么样？

they don't all die. but the ones who survive will look very different
他们不会全都死去。但那些活下来的人将会看起来非常不同。

the low-end creators - the ones charging $150 on fiverr to read a script in front of their iphone - they're done. AI does that job faster, cheaper, and more consistently
低端创作者——那些在 Fiverr 上收费 150 美元为 iPhone 前朗读脚本的人——他们完了。AI 能更快、更便宜、更稳定地完成这项工作。

the creators who survive will be the ones who evolve into AI creative directors. people who understand direct response, who can write hooks that stop the scroll, who know how to structure a script that converts - and who use AI as their production tool instead of competing against it
能够幸存下来的创作者将是那些演变为 AI 创意总监的人——也就是理解直接响应、能写出阻止用户滚动的钩子、懂得构建能转化的脚本，并且将 AI 作为创作工具而非与其竞争的人。

think about it like photography. when the iphone killed point-and-shoot cameras, photographers didn't disappear. but the ones who survived were the ones with actual creative vision - not just the ability to press a shutter button
可以把它想象成摄影。当 iPhone 淘汰了傻瓜相机时，摄影师并没有消失。但活下来的是那些真正有创意眼光的人——而不仅仅是按快门的能力。

same thing is happening now. the "skill" of sitting in front of a camera and reading a script is getting automated. the skill of knowing what to say, how to structure it, and how to make someone buy - that's more valuable than ever
同样的事情现在正在发生。坐在镜头前读脚本的“技能”正在被自动化。知道该说什么、如何组织内容以及如何让别人购买的“技能”——这比以往任何时候都更有价值。

what comes next
接下来是什么

the next wave isn't "AI vs human" content. it's AI-powered content operations run by small teams and solo operators

here's what that looks like in practice:

one person running 10+ AI avatars across different niches generating 50-100 ad variations per week instead of 5 using AI voice cloning to create consistent brand voices building entire "creator" personas that don't exist but perform like real influencers testing hooks and scripts at a speed that was impossible 12 months ago

the people who figure this out first are building unfair advantages that compound every single month

and the brands are following the results. they don't care if the creator is real or AI. they care about CPAs and ROAS. that's it

the real opportunity

most brands are still 2-3 years behind on this. they're still hiring UGC creators the old way, still waiting a week for one video, still spending way too much on creative production or hire random AI creators just to test and run AI slop ads that looks like videos made 10 months ago with some shitty comfyui workflow, then they say it doesn’t make sense and become against it

that gap between what's possible with AI and what brands are actually doing right now - that's where the money is

if you can position yourself as the person who bridges that gap - who brings AI-powered creative production to brands and your work is high quality - you're sitting on a goldmine, literal goldmine

you don't sell "AI content." you sell faster creative, more ad variations, lower production costs, and better performance. the AI part is just how you deliver it

how i actually make an AI UGC ad from scratch

let me walk you through the high-level process so you can see why this is a problem for traditional creators

step 1 - the script

i use AI (Claude to be exact) to generate a full UGC script - hook, voiceover, visual directions, timestamps, actions - all in one output

but here's the thing most people miss - you can't just type "make me a ugc script" and expect gold

you need to feed the AI context. reference videos that went viral, storytelling frameworks, the product's angle. the more context you give, the better the output + Claude skills are a cheatcode

step 2 - the creator

i generate one

take reference face, regenerate into a new unique face that fits the vibe of the content

a beauty product needs someone who looks like your best friend giving skincare advice, not a stock photo model

i generate these in 4k because details matter - skin texture, pores, lighting. if it doesn't look real at full resolution it won't fool anyone in a video

pinterest is your best friend here for finding reference material that matches the energy you're going for

step 3 - the video

this is where tools like Kling 3.0, VEO or Sora changed the game

you take your generated creator image, combine it with the product, and generate video clips with control shots - talking to camera, cutting to product application, reaction shots, close-ups, voiceover text and emotions

the key is directing it like a real shoot. you're not just generating random motion - you're telling the AI to cut between specific shots that match your script

first frame is everything

step 4 - the voice

the raw AI voice sometimes can sound off

so i go find real UGC creators on tiktok who have the voice i want, clone that voice style using ElevenLabs, then re-do the voiceover so it sounds natural
所以我去找 TikTok 上真正的用户生成内容创作者，他们有我想要的声音，克隆那个声音风格，使用 ElevenLabs，然后重做旁白，让它听起来自然

you can also try to fix voice issues with adobe podcast tool

step 5 - finishing touches

before/after images to hook people with the transformation. sound effects on every cut and transition to keep attention

branded product shots generated with AI. text overlays. every element is designed to keep people's eyes moving so they never stop long enough to question if the creator is real

the whole process takes me about 30 minutes per ad

a traditional UGC creator takes days for one video. and i can spin up 10 variations of the same concept - different hooks, creators and scripts - all in an afternoon

i'm not showing you all workflows here, but even this breakdown should make it obvious why $300/video UGC creators are in trouble

i've spent the last year building AI ad workflows, testing every tool on the market, and packaging everything into systems that actually work for real brands spending real money

if you want to learn how to build AI-generated ads, sell creative services to brands, monetize it with AI influencers, digital products, affiliation... and stay ahead of the curve while 99% of people are still figuring out what prompt to type - come join us

点击这里
